elements.content: Grammar focus: Self-Correction & Real-time Hedging Structures.

Core Rule: Deploy spontaneous reformulation markers ( or rather , that is to say , more precisely ) and real-time epistemic hedges ( if I may put it thus , to all intents and purposes ) to recalibrate claims in real time.

Immediate Self-Correction — or rather / or more accurately: The project was a failure, or rather , a valuable learning experience.
Precision Clarification — that is to say / in other words: The policy is insolvent; that is to say , liabilities exceed assets.
Epistemic Stance Modifiers — if I may be so bold / so to speak: It is, if I may be so bold , a major strategic miscalculation.
Scope Restriction — to all intents and purposes / broadly speaking: The agreement is, to all intents and purposes , null and void.
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Which phrase serves as an elegant spontaneous reformulation marker?
2. What is the pragmatic purpose of real-time epistemic hedging?
options: To modulate stance and avoid dogmatic assertions in live debate
To confuse the listener with contradictory facts
